payload.summary: Corrected the operational job.report example to reference a real synthetic fixture with its SHA-256, added root-bound success and stale-digest regression coverage, updated the bundle checksum, and built a CRC/hash-verified cumulative A004 source snapshot.
findings: Root cause: job.report.json used an all-zero digest for a real source path, so root-bound artifact validation failed. The example now references the synthetic-candidate fixture whose actual SHA-256 is in the packet.

A001 source snapshot was not available as contemporaneous bytes. All seven entries in the A001 candidate manifest were verified against current bytes or retrospective reconstructions that match the recorded SHA-256 exactly; reconstructed files are labeled retrospective.

Assigned A002 candidate manifest bytes and digest were preserved exactly. This attempt changes three files from its listed input candidate (job.report.json, SHA256SUMS.txt, tests/test_contracts.py); cumulative A004 manifest records current hashes.
